title: The Maho-Maho Kingdom on the Beach

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The crew hop on a boat and cross the ocean,
arriving at their destination. Once there,
they change into their swimsuits and get ready to enjoy the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
船に乗って海を渡り、海水浴場へとやってきた
{0}と【自警団（カォン）】のメンバーたち。
マホたちは水着に着替え、浜辺で準備をしていた。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I'll need protection from the rays.
It's time for the ol' parasol from Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
陽射しに当たりすぎんよう、
パラソルを差して、
と。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
There we go.
Been a li'l while since we last went out. The wind feels mighty
fine, too. If there was ever a time for a swim, it's now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
これでええね。
久しぶりのお出かけで、
みんな気持ちよさそうや。
風も気持ちええし、
海水浴日和やね。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
*huff, puff*
I can't believe we had to lug every single
plushie at the guildhouse along with us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
まさか、
ギルドハウスにあったぬいぐるみを、
全部持ってくる羽目になるとは……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Now that's what I call a warm-up!
text_block_list.orig_text: いい準備運動になったよ～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Princess.
What made you bring these all in the first place?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぁ姫さん、
なんでわざわざ
ぬいぐるみを持ってくる必要があったんだ？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Makoto. These li'l ones are part of the Caon family.
It'd be terrible if we left them back home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはん。
この子たちも
仲間なんやから。
仲間外れはいけませんえ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
She really treats those plushies well.
And hey! The more the merrier. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホはぬいぐるみたちを大切にしてるからね～
仲間がいっぱい、
にぎやかで楽しいさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I know just how well she treats them.
But I gotta admit, they do look extra cute when lined up on the beach like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫さんがぬいぐるみを大切にしてるのは知ってるよ。
まぁ確かに、
海辺にこうやって並んでるのを見ると
かわいいよな。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll be!
Glad you understand just how charming they are. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはんにも
この愛らしさが伝わったようで
何よりやわ♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on.
It's not like I hate cute stuff or anything.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃあたしだって……
かわいいのが嫌いなわけじゃねぇしよ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: If anything, you're more attached to them than most of the other members.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトはギルドの中でも
結構ぬいぐるみをかわいがってるよね～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Kaori! Don't go running your mouth like that!
A-ahem. S-speaking of other members,
we gotta talk about Kasumi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だぁぁ言うなってのカオリ！
ご、ごほん。
そ、
そういや仲間と言えばよ、
カスミのやつ、
姫さんが用意してくれた旅行だってのに……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
The princess went to the effort of arranging all this,
but Kasumi had the nerve to refuse because her books could get damaged.
text_block_list.orig_text:
「私は遠慮するよ。
海に本を持っていくと、
傷んでしまうからね」
なんて言いやがって……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry that pretty li'l head of yours now, Makoto. Much as
I'd have loved for her to join us, I reckon we'll have a much easier
time relaxing knowin' that the guildhouse is in her safe hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ。
一緒に来られんかったのは
残念やけど、
カスミはんが
【自警団（カォン）】の留守を守ってくれるんやったら、
うちらも安心して
羽を伸ばせるやろ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: I mean, you're not wrong...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
そりゃそうだけどよ……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Wh-where'd that come from?! As if!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ななっ、
何言ってんだ！
　違うっての！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Besides, take a gander over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにほら、
見てみ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It's the ocean! Time to swim!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海やっさ～！
　泳ぐよ～～～！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Holy! She dove in at lightning speed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はやっ！？
　カオリのやつ、
もう海に飛び込んでやがる！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Right?
You just hafta to go all out and enjoy it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
な？
　思いっきり楽しんだもんの
勝ちどすえ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, fair enough.
I'm surprised you knew about this place, though.
Sure feels a lot different from the Marjan Coast.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
そうだよな。
にしても姫さん、
よくこんなとこ知ってたな？
マルジェン海岸とはだいぶ違う雰囲気だよな、
この海。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Kaori tells us all sorts of things about her homeland, doesn't she?
I reckoned she'd enjoy somewhere
with a similar atmosphere, so I did some diggin'.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カオリはんの故郷の話、
よぉ聞かされてたやろ？
少しでも楽しんでもらうために、
似た感じの場所を探してたんよ。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Always a pleasure to be praised by you, my prince.
I wouldn't mind if ya kept it up, in all honesty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんに
褒めてもらえると
うれしいなぁ。
ついでに、
もっと
褒めてくれても
ええんよ？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with the swimsuits we brought.
Perk those ears up now, Makoto.
The praise'll be comin' any second now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日のうちらの水着、
どうやろか。
ほら、
マコトはんも
耳を立てて
感想を待ってはりますよ？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Why's [i]that[/i] the topic you had to choose?!
Hey, you! Quit staring!
choice_data_list: You both look cute in them.
Quite the alluring pick, I'd say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何言いだしてんだ姫さん！？
っていうかジロジロこっち見んな！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Q-quit it already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっ、
やめろよなそういうの！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
That's my prince for ya.
Always honest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
さすがは王子はん、
飾らへん言葉が
心地ええわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: You better not be looking at us with pervy eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おまっ、
どういう見方してんだよ！？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
He is a boy, after all.
Happy as I am, though, it is a li'l bit embarrassing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
王子はんも男の子やね。
うれしいけど、
少し恥ずかしいわぁ。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up? You're both red as a tomato.
More importantly, {0}! Let's go for a swim!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　どうしたさ～？
　マコトもマホも顔が赤いさ～？
それより、
{0}も来るさ～！
　一緒に泳ぐさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're still not used to swimming?
Oh, right.Amnesia and all that!
But don't worry. I'm right here with you! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
　まだ泳ぐのに慣れてない？
そっか、
{0}は記憶喪失だったね～！
でも大丈夫さ～、
私が付いてるよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Look! There's nothing to be afraid of.
Ease yourself up and you'll be able to float. ♪
Okay, I'll let go now. There!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
海は怖いものじゃないさ～
体の力を抜いていれば
沈まないさ～♪
じゃあ、
手を離すよ～、
はいっ！

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Kaori! He's drowning!
Totally drowning!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいカオリ！
　沈んでる！
　そいつ沈んでるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oh no. Grab onto me!
That's it. Don't panic. Just relax.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらら、
私に掴まるさ～！
んっ、
慌てない慌てない、
リラックスするさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. All calmed down now?
Then it'd be nice if you eased your grip a bit.
My swimsuit's just about to come off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
落ち着いてきた？
じゃあそろそろ、
手の力を緩めてほしいかな～
水着が外れちゃいそうさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'm the one that rushed you.
Okay, ease yourself up again. Relax. It's all about being relaxed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にしなくていいよ～、
急ぎすぎた私が悪かったさ～
力を抜いて～、
リラックス、
リラックスよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I'm sure you were scared,
so hold on for as long as you want.
It'd be nice if you held onto a different part of me, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいよいいよ。
怖かったよねぇ。
好きなだけつかまってていいさ～
でも、
手の位置は少しだけ
ずらしてくれるとうれしいさ～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
How are our stomachs holding up, y'all?
What say we head back and get ourselves some lunch?
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな、
そろそろお腹も空いてきたやろ？
一旦浜辺に戻って、
お昼ごはんにせぇへん？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Sounds good to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう、
そうだな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Sure wish they had goya here.
text_block_list.orig_text: ここにゴーヤーがあったら最高なんだけどね～

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I made lunch with that in mind.
Though it's a goya veggie stir-fry, not the real thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言うと思って弁当に入れといたよ。
まぁ、
ゴーヤーっぽいもの炒め
だけどな。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Anything you make is perfect to me. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトが作ったものなら
何でも大好物だよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh. You've sure got a way with words.
Hm? What's got you frozen up like that, Princess?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく上手いことばっか言いやがって。
あれ、
姫さんどうした？
　急に立ち止まって。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong, Maho?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マホ、
どうかしたさ～？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Why...?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうして……

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Princess? What's the deal... 
Hold up. What's going on here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
姫さん？
　どうしたんだよ、
って……
おい、
これはどういうこった？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The parasol means this is definitely our spot, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
パラソルも差してあるし、
場所は間違ってないよね～？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Sure, we weren't looking and all, but there's just no way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
目を離してたのは確かだけど、
あれだけの数だぜ？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: They're definitely all gone, though.
text_block_list.orig_text: でもどこにも見当たらないさ～

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text: みんな……

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Where did all the li'l ones go?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぬいぐるみのみんな、
どこに行ってしもうたん……？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Maho and co. stared in disbelief at the area where Maho's plushies
had initially been lined up, not a single one left anywhere in sight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
愕然とするマホたち。
仲良く並んでいたぬいぐるみたちが、
浜辺から一体残らずいなくなっていた。
